title: Transcriptome profiling of PBMCs and formalin-fixed autopsy tissues from COVID-19 patients
protocol: Isolate RNA from PBMC samples using the RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Isolate RNA from FFPE samples using the AllPrep DNA/RNA FFPE Kit (Qiagen) according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Add 10 μL β-mercaptoethanol to 1 mL RLT Buffer before use.
Add 4 volumes of 100% ethanol to RPE Buffer.
Prepare 70% ethanol.
Resuspend PBMC pellet in 600 μL RLT Buffer without centrifuging.
Add 600 μL 70% ethanol to the homogenized cell pellet and mix by pipetting.
Transfer 600 μL sample to a RNeasy spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s.
Discard the flow-through and re-use the collection tube.
Centrifuge the remaining 600 μL sample at 10,000×g for 30 s using the same RNeasy spin column.
Discard the flow-through after centrifugation.
Add 700 μL RW1 Buffer to the column and carefully close the lid.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s and discard the flow-through.
Re-use the same collection tube.
Add 500 μL RPE Buffer to the column and spin at 10,000×g for 30 s.
Discard the flow-through after centrifugation.
Re-use the collection tube.
Add 500 μL RPE Buffer to the column and spin at 10,000×g for 2 min.
Remove the spin column and discard the flow-through.
Place the column into a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 12,000×g for 1 min.
Place the column into a new 1.5 mL collection tube and add 25 μL RNase free water to the column membrane.
Close the lid and leave the columns on the bench for 1 min.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 1 min.
Deparaffinize using xylene; add 1 mL xylene and vortex vigorously for 10 s, then centrifuge at 10,000×g for 2 min.
Remove the supernatant by either pipetting without disturbing the pellet or pouring it into a fresh tube.
Add 1 mL 100% ethanol, vortex and centrifuge at 10,000×g for 2 min.
Remove the supernatant as indicated in ‘b’.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 min with the lid open.
Add 150 μL PKD Buffer and flick the tube to loosen the pellet.
Add 10 μL proteinase K and vortex.
Incubate at 56°C for 15 min.
Incubate on ice for 3 min.
Centrifuge at 20,000×g for 15 min.
Set the heating block at 80°C during centrifugation.
Transfer the supernatant without disturbing the pellet into a new 2 mL safe-lock microcentrifuge tube for RNA purification.
Incubate the supernatant at 80°C for 15 min.
Briefly centrifuge to remove drops from the lid.
Add 320 μL RLT Buffer and mix by pipetting.
Add 1,120 μL 100% ethanol and mix by pipetting.
Transfer 700 μL sample (including precipitates that may have formed) to a RNeasy MinElute spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s.
Repeat the step until the entire sample volume has passed through the column.
Add 350 μL FRN Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s; discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μL FRN Buffer to the column and centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s.
Place the column into a new 2 mL collection tube supplied with the kit.
Apply the flow-through to the column.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μL RPE Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 μL RPE Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 30 s to wash the column membrane.
Discard the collection tube and the flow-through.
Place the column into a new 2 mL collection tube supplied with the kit.
Centrifuge at 10,000×g for 5 min keeping the lid open.
Place the column into a new 1.5 mL collection tube supplied with the kit.
Add 20 μL RNase free water to the column membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 min.
Centrifuge at 12,000×g for 1 min.
Measure the concentration of RNA isolated from PBMC and/or FFPE samples using NanoDrop Spectrophotometer.
Bring the RNA samples along with RNase free water used to elute them on ice to the NanoDrop Spectrophotometer Station.
Clean the sample reader with molecular grade water and wipe with a KimWipe.
Load 1.2 μL of RNase free water and initialize the system.
Select 'RNA' and click 'blank'.
Load 1.2 μL of RNA sample and click ‘measure’.
Record the A260/280 and A260/A230 ratios along with the RNA concentration (ng/mL).
Wipe the sample reader between samples with a clean KimWipe.
Repeat steps e-f for subsequent samples.
Check RNA integrity using Agilent Bioanalyzer.
Use 2.5 μL per sample for the integrity check.
Pre-heat the thermocycler to 65°C (lid temperature 70°C).
Program the thermocycler for an 18 μL volume.
Thaw the Reporter Code Set (nCounter CAR T Characterization Panel) at room temperature.
Thaw the Capture Probe Set (nCounter CAR T Characterization Panel) at room temperature.
Thaw PLUS COVID-19 Reporter at room temperature.
Invert or flick the thawed tubes several times and spin down tubes at less than 1,000×g for less than 30 seconds.
Add 28 μL of PLUS COVID-19 Reporter to the Reporter Code Set.
Invert or flick the mixture several times and spin down the tube.
Prepare a master mix by adding 70 μL of hybridization Buffer to the tube containing PLUS COVID-19 Reporter and Reporter Code Set.
Label tubes.
Add 10 μL of the master mix into each tube.
Add 100 ng of RNA sample per tube.
Adjust volume with RNase free water if less than 5 μL.
Ensure total volume per tube is 15 μL.
Add 14 μL of Capture PLUS Reagent to the thawed aliquot of Capture Probe Set.
Invert several times and spin down reagents.
Add 3 μL of Capture Probe Set and Capture Plus Reagent mix into each tube immediately before placing it at 65°C.
Incubate in the thermocycler at 65°C for 18 h.
Ramp the reaction down to 4°C.
Remove samples from the thermocycler and spin them down on day 2.
Ensure no evaporation has occurred and all samples have the same volume.
Take the two 96-well plates from the refrigerator at 4°C.
Spin the plates down at 2,000×g for 2 minutes.
Remove the cartridge from the −20°C freezer.
Prepare the nCounter Prep Station based on the manufacturer’s instructions.
Place the plates on the deck with labels forward.
Discard the lids of the plates.
Remove the foil from the cartridge.
Check that the bottom of the cartridge is not cracked or damaged before loading.
Load the cartridge under the electrode fixture with the notch in the back and barcode on the right.
Ensure the right side bounces up and down after applying light pressure with your finger.
Lower the electrode fixture to insert the electrodes into the cartridge.
Cover the tips (supplied with the kit) with a plate lid to facilitate loading.
Place the tip sheaths in the slot in front of the tip rack.
Insert empty strip tubes, provided with the kit, into the heater block.
Uncap the sample strip tubes and place them into the metal tube holder.
Close the heater lid and click ‘Start Processing’.
Wait 10 minutes until the ‘System Processing’ message appears on the display.
Remove the cartridge from the nCounter Prep Station after 3 hours of processing.
Seal the cartridge with the clear adhesive film within 1 hour after processing.
Clean the nCounter Prep Station following the instructions shown on the display.
Retrieve the NanoString supplied USB from −80°C.
Load the Reporter Library File (RLF) from the NanoString USB onto the nCounter Digital Analyzer.
Insert the NanoString supplied USB into the nCounter Digital Analyzer port.
Follow the on-screen instructions to upload files and then upload RLF files.
Click on ‘Start Counting’ and select a stage position on the touch screen.
Place the cartridge in the selected stage position by holding it lengthwise.
Close the magnetic clip and push down to ensure the cartridge is flat.
Under Cartridge Definition Mode, select ‘Create New’ for generic sample names.
Enter a cartridge ID.
Select fields of view (FOV) count for scanning. Use the maximum FOV count (555).
Click 'Samples' and select all sample tubes.
Enter a 'Sample ID'; individual samples will be differentiated by lane numbers.
Click 'Library RLF' and select the RLF that corresponds to the CodeSet being run.
Click 'Done' to return to the Cartridge Information Screen.
Click 'Done' again to return to the Select Stage Position Screen.
Click 'Done' for the third time if no additional scans are planned.
Click 'Start'.
Insert a USB drive into the Digital Analyzer USB port once the scan has completed.
Click ‘Download data’ from the touch screen.
Select the file corresponding to the cartridge ID and click 'Download data'.
Export Reporter Code Count (RCC) files.
